name: TclBanker — RuntimeOptimizeService Scheduled Task
description: Detects creation of TclBanker's signature scheduled task RuntimeOptimizeService via schtasks.exe
query: process where event.action == "start" and process.name : "schtasks.exe" and process.command_line : ("*RuntimeOptimizeService*" and "*create*")
author: F0RT1KA

name: TclBanker — LogiAiPromptBuilder.exe From Non-Standard Path
description: Detects TclBanker's sideload host EXE (LogiAiPromptBuilder.exe) executing from a path that is not the legitimate Logitech install directory
query: process where event.action == "start" and process.name : "LogiAiPromptBuilder.exe" and not process.executable : ("?:\\Program Files\\Logi*\\*", "?:\\Program Files (x86)\\Logi*\\*")
author: F0RT1KA

name: TclBanker — screen_retriever_plugin.dll Image Load Outside Logitech Path
description: Detects image load of screen_retriever_plugin.dll from a non-Logitech directory — TclBanker's signature sideloaded DLL
query: library where event.action == "load" and dll.name : "screen_retriever_plugin.dll" and not dll.path : ("?:\\Program Files\\Logi*\\*", "?:\\Program Files (x86)\\Logi*\\*")
author: F0RT1KA

name: TclBanker — Cloudflare Workers C2 DNS Lookup (account ef971a42)
description: Detects DNS queries for *.workers.dev domains containing the TclBanker Cloudflare account identifier
query: network where event.action == "lookup_requested" and dns.question.name : "*workers.dev" and dns.question.name : ("*ef971a42*", "*tcl-banker*", "*tclbanker*")
author: F0RT1KA

name: TclBanker — Debug Artifact C:\temp\tcl-debug.txt
description: Detects creation of the distinctive TclBanker debug-artifact file
author: F0RT1KA

name: TclBanker — Logitech_Update_*.msi Drop Outside Software-Update Paths
description: Detects MSI files matching the TclBanker filename shape (Logitech_Update_*.msi) outside legitimate software-update directories
query: file where event.action == "creation" and file.name regex~ "Logitech_Update_[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+\.msi" and not file.path : ("?:\\Program Files\\*", "?:\\Windows\\Installer\\*")
author: F0RT1KA

name: TclBanker — Killchain Sequence (sideload + persistence within 5 minutes)
description: Sequence detection: TclBanker DLL sideload followed by RuntimeOptimizeService task creation on the same host within 5 minutes
query: sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m [library where event.action == "load" and dll.name : "screen_retriever_plugin.dll"] [process where event.action == "start" and process.name : "schtasks.exe" and process.command_line : "*RuntimeOptimizeService*"]
author: F0RT1KA
